# Differential fuzz benchmark history

<!-- Generated by `python -m harness.fuzz.history rebuild` from the JSON entries under history/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Each run fuzzes one product against its reference system (logs vs Loki, metrics vs Prometheus or Mimir, traces vs Tempo) on a local Docker stack, then records correctness outcomes, query and ingest latency, and container CPU and memory. See the [benchmark guide](../README.md) for what the numbers mean and how to add a run. Machine-readable data: [index.json](index.json).
